title: PlanningEstimates
description: The Architect Reviewer's t-shirt sizing of candidate / committed features, persisted as .consort/planning/estimates.json. Produced by the architect `estimate` turn (and merged by `estimate-committed`); consumed by readEstimates (consort-paths.ts), which keys each entry by feature_id + size. Each entry MUST carry feature_id (the candidate/real feature id, verbatim) and a t-shirt size; rationale and any richer fields (title/confidence/drivers/risks/depends_on, …) are allowed. feature_id is REQUIRED — an entry keyed by `id` (or any other name) is dropped by the consumer, which empties the backlog.

feature_id.description: The feature id this estimate is for, used VERBATIM (candidate id e.g. FP1 for `estimate`, real feature id e.g. F1 for `estimate-committed`). This exact key — NOT `id` — is what the consumer reads.

rationale.description: One-line justification for the size (optional but expected).
